forms.title: Rate problems
forms.skill: Closing-the-gap motion: rates add.

variants.statement: Two cars start $200$ km apart and drive toward each other, one at $40$ km/h and the other at $60$ km/h. After how many hours do they meet?
variants.explanation: Together they close the gap at $40 + 60 = 100$ km/h, so $t = \dfrac{200}{100} = 2$ hours. Rates ADD when the motion is toward each other — subtracting is the chasing-problem formula.
